verdict.rationale: Devin's Computer Use gives it a full desktop with browser, mouse/keyboard control, and screenshots, and docs mention reproducing and fixing bugs, which together support live debugging of a running web app. However, there's no explicit documentation of dev-tools/console/breakpoint integration or independent evidence of successfully debugging a live app end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit browser devtools/console integration for live inspection, hands-on/independent verification of live-app debugging workflows.
